nodes.title: Ouverture
nodes.text:
Merry: So it WAS bandits! I knew it.
Stiff: See, you're not such a no-good.
_
Stiff: Anyway, let's get this going. They should be close now.

nodes.title: Interlude
nodes.text:
Gizzard: Told you it was bandits.
Merry: You said undead. And animals. And kids.
Gizzard: … One of those was bound to land.

nodes.title: Fin
nodes.text:
Stiff: That's the lot of them.
Merry: Same time tomorrow, Sarge?
Stiff: …
Gizzard: He means yes.
